speaker: (the vicar)
text: Patience, good people. It is the third word of the text, and I will not leave it until it has done its work.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Sit, son. Thy father's place is the empty board. Leave it empty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have counted the row. Mother, Anne, three children, Joan, two brothers. One gap.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He told thee why. Do not improve it into a better reason while the psalm is up.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Richard is on thy left. Edmund has Hamnet's heel and will not let it kick the kneeler.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Richard is in his place. The gap is not his to fill.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I could sit forward, and the row would look whole from the back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sit where you are. A gap is a true thing. Let the sermon cover the rest.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He has said patience four times. Judith counted three. She stopped when he smiled.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The third time he smiled. I do not count smiles. I count the word.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: The fourth time is for those who think a debt may be paid by staying away from the place where debts are read.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That was not meant for this pew. Keep thy face still.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was meant for half the town. I am one man in a row, and a gap.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Your father has a shop to mind. That is a reason a neighbour can carry home.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Sit, Edmund. The gap is not a seat. Leaning into it will not fill it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have told him the paper is lighter. He will not thank the cause.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then leave it, husband. I asked my question yesterday. I am not asking it under a hymn.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not brought thee a fourth answer in my pocket.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: A patient man pays what he owes and then sits down. He does not send a story in his place.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Does he mean the bailiff's man?

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: He means the parish. Fold thy hands.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The sword is on the nail. He counted it once before we came.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: That is not a prayer. That is an inventory.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Inventories are what he writes when he will not write the hard sentence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hush. We are still in the first patience. The glass has not been turned.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Amen, then. Dinner can have the rest of the talking.
